relations.justification: Quantum mechanics is formulated as a modification of Hamiltonian mechanics; the classical structure is what gets quantised.
Thermodynamics is stated in the mechanical quantities classical mechanics defines.
Wave mechanics generalises oscillation, which is a classical-mechanical problem.
Quantum electrodynamics is where the quantum and electromagnetic descriptions become one theory; the photon is the junction.
Nuclear structure and decay are quantum results — barrier penetration and shell filling have no classical account.
Biophysical mechanism — photosynthesis, enzyme catalysis, molecular motors — is quantum and statistical physics applied to biological matter.
Statistical mechanics needs a microscopic state count, and the quantum count is the one that gives the correct third-law behaviour.
Gravitational contraction converting to thermal energy is what ignites and sustains a star.
Stellar structure is a thermodynamic equilibrium problem before it is anything else.
Chemical equilibrium and reaction spontaneity are thermodynamic results.
Differential solar heating and the thermodynamics of moist air are what drive atmospheric circulation.
The second law and the entropy bound on compression are the same statement about the number of accessible configurations.
Thermodynamic equilibrium is the canonical example of a stable fixed point and supplies the vocabulary the systems account uses.
Thermodynamic and quantum constants are what fix the second and the kelvin; the definitions are physical results.
Quantum mechanics is a wave theory; the mathematics of superposition is inherited.
Geophysical method is largely applied electromagnetism and wave propagation — magnetics, resistivity and seismic imaging.
Quantum mechanics superseded classical mechanics as the fundamental account while leaving it exact in its limit, which is the standard shape of theory replacement.
Astrophysics beyond the stellar interior is general relativity: cosmology, compact objects and lensing are its consequences.
Quantum gravity is the attempt to reconcile relativity with quantum theory and is unintelligible without both.
Wave and particle descriptions of matter are complementary rather than competing, and chemistry uses both — orbitals are waves, reactions are collisions.
Particle physics generalises the nuclear case: the same scattering and conservation apparatus at higher energy.
Radiometric measurement requires a time standard; the decay clock is only as good as the clock reading it.
Unification programmes are attempts to complete the particle-physics account; they presuppose the standard model they extend.
Detector background is a worked example of a noise model determining what signal can be recovered.
Stellar nucleosynthesis is the origin account cosmochemistry uses to explain elemental abundance.
Seismology is applied geophysics; the wave theory and the Earth model are one subject approached from two catalogues.
Earthquake magnitude distributions and cascading-failure sizes follow the same power law, and the criticality account is shared.
Biophysics derives its energetic arguments from statistical thermodynamics applied to macromolecules.
Biophysics depends on cell biology for the systems whose mechanics and energetics it measures.
A quantum theory of gravity must contradict general relativity somewhere — the two are jointly inconsistent, which is the entire motivation for the programme.
Chemical bonding is quantum mechanics applied to electrons; the periodic law is a physical result.
Organic chemistry presupposes bonding, stoichiometry and equilibrium from the general course.
Inorganic chemistry is periodicity and bonding applied across the table; the general principles come first.
Physical chemistry formalises what general chemistry introduces qualitatively.
Biochemistry is the organic chemistry of a specific set of molecules; the functional-group vocabulary is prior.
Medicinal chemistry is structure-activity reasoning over organic scaffolds.
Analytical method rests on the spectroscopy and equilibrium theory physical chemistry supplies.
Computational chemistry solves the equations physical chemistry writes down.
Chemical equilibrium exemplifies a dynamic steady state — flux in both directions, no net change.
Le Chatelier displacement and comparative statics are the same reasoning — perturb a parameter, read the shift in equilibrium.
Analytical chemistry supports archaeological science — provenance, residue and isotope work are analytical results.
Analytical results are measurements; detection limits and uncertainty are the discipline's core claims.
An analytical result requires calibration against a traceable standard; without it the number is a reading, not a measurement.
Biochemistry derives directly from organic chemistry and retains its structural reasoning.
Molecular biology is biochemistry with an informational overlay; the chemistry of the polymers is prior to the code they carry.
Chemical pollution is a principal driver of ecological change, and the exposure pathway is a chemistry question before it is an ecological one.
Waste and chemicals regulation depends on environmental chemistry for the fate and transport models the limits are set from.
A drug exists as a molecule before it has a pharmacology; medicinal chemistry precedes the dose-response study.
Nanomaterials are materials chemistry at a scale where surface dominates; the bulk chemistry is the baseline it departs from.
Computation superseded measurement for many structural questions that were once analytical problems, though it did not remove the need for empirical validation.
Biochemistry is the substrate of modern biology; molecular mechanism is stated in chemical terms.
Cell biology is read in molecular terms; the machinery is described before the compartment that houses it.
Molecular genetics is the mechanism classical genetics describes phenomenologically.
Molecular accounts superseded purely electrophysiological ones for many neural phenomena, without displacing the systems level.
Microbiology is cell biology of single-celled organisms and shares its methods.
Neurobiology is the cell biology of excitable membranes; the ion gradients are cell biology before they are neuroscience.
Cellular compartmentation and modular system design are the same solution to the same problem: separate what must not interact.
Mutation and recombination are what generate the variation selection acts on; without them evolution has no input.
Evolutionary theory needs an inheritance mechanism; the modern synthesis is genetics joined to selection.
The gene concept is what molecular genetics defines operationally, and the definition has moved with the technique.
Genetic engineering is genetics made directional; the mechanism is what the technique manipulates.
Human genetic data requires a lawful processing basis; it is the most strongly protected category in every data-protection regime.
Ecological interaction is read as adaptation; the evolutionary account is what makes a strategy intelligible.
Zoological classification is a claim about descent, so the evolutionary account is prior to the taxonomy.
Botanical systematics likewise encodes phylogeny rather than similarity.
Evolutionary search and stochastic optimisation are the same algorithm class; genetic algorithms made the borrowing explicit.
Evolutionary accounts of origin contradict literal creation narratives; the disagreement is about what kind of claim each is making, and comparative religion treats that as its subject.
Marine biology is ecology in a specific medium whose physical constraints shape every interaction.
An ecosystem exemplifies an open system: it maintains structure by dissipating an energy flow.
Ecological competition and market competition share the exclusion result: two populations on one limiting resource do not coexist without differentiation.
Nature conservation law depends on ecology for the habitat and population criteria its designations use.
Biogeography is ecology with distribution as the explanandum; the interaction theory is prior to the spatial pattern.
Infectious disease epidemiology presupposes the microbiology of the agent it tracks.
Microbiological identification supports outbreak investigation; the epidemiological claim rests on the laboratory one.
Neuroscience as a discipline extends neurobiology with systems and cognitive levels the cell account does not reach.
Evolutionary and social-movement dynamics share a variation-selection-retention structure, though the inheritance mechanism differs and the analogy is often overdrawn.
Homeostatic regulation is the worked example of negative feedback, complete with sensor, comparator and effector.
Immune defence and computer security share the architecture — signature recognition, anomaly detection and a memory of past attacks — and the vocabulary was borrowed deliberately.
Immune regulation is a worked example of negative feedback with a threshold and an effector arm.
Anatomy presupposes the cell and tissue biology that explains what the structures are made of.
Atmospheric circulation is what produces the regional climate pattern geography describes.
Climate zonation is what produces the biome pattern regional geography describes.
